transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess… I’m here because I’ve been having a hard time staying seated in long sales strategy meetings. I keep getting up when I know I’m supposed to stay put—like to refill my water or just sort of pace by the printer.
Have there been times when you felt unusually energetic or high along with this restlessness?
Um… not really, I don’t think. I mean, I get restless, but I wouldn’t say “high” or unusually energetic. It’s more just… hard to sit still.
Do you often have trouble paying attention during meetings?
Yeah… especially if they run long. I’ll start out following the meeting, but after a few minutes I realize I’ve just been staring at the same slide and I don’t really know what was just said.
Did you have trouble paying attention like this when you were a child?

Yeah… I think so. It goes back pretty far, before high school. I remember in elementary school my teachers would write things like I was bright, but I rushed through work, talked when I wasn’t supposed to, forgot homework, and my desk was always kind of… full of half-finished papers.
Do you often feel hard-to-control worry about everyday things?
Not really… I mean, I worry about normal stuff sometimes, but I wouldn’t say it feels hard to control most of the time.
Do these attention and restlessness problems also cause trouble for you outside of work?

Mostly it’s been at work, honestly. It’s… started coming up in performance reviews, and I had a client complain once, which kind of scared me. I don’t want to mess up accounts or make people think I don’t care, because I do.
Do these attention and restlessness problems also cause problems for you at home?
Um… I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed it causing big problems at home, not like at work. I guess I’d have to think about it.
At home, do these attention or restlessness problems ever cause you problems?
I don’t know… not really that I’ve noticed. Home feels a little less pressured, so it’s harder for me to tell.
At home, have these attention or restlessness problems ever caused an argument or other problem?
I don’t think so… not an argument, at least. Nothing specific comes to mind.
Have these attention problems ever caused trouble for you while driving?
Not that I can think of. I mean, driving is usually pretty routine for me, so… I haven’t noticed any real trouble with it.
Have these attention or restlessness problems ever caused trouble for you in school?

Yeah… school, I guess. I remember it going back pretty early, like elementary school. Teachers would say I was bright, but I rushed through things, talked when I wasn’t supposed to, forgot homework… my desk was always full of half-done papers.
Do these attention problems make it hard for you to keep up with chores at home?
A little, yeah. I’ll start chores and get most of it done, but then I leave the last part hanging… like I meant to finish it and just don’t quite close the loop.
